reviews.text: We’ve had such an amazing experience with Wags and couldn’t be happier with the care they’ve given our puppy, Krembo! The front desk staff is always so nice, welcoming, and helpful every time we come in. Dr. Laura Sanchez is amazing and has made us feel completely comfortable and confident with Krembo’s care. Our vet assistant, Ocean, is incredibly kind and so sweet with Krembo. Their pricing is very fair, especially for the level of care and attention they provide. We just got Krembo a few weeks ago, and Wags will absolutely be our vet for as long as we’re living in Miami!

I was so nervous about my chi’s major dental surgery. Dr. Ori, Stephany, and the whole team at WAGS answered all of our questions, concerns, and were overall such a great care team to work with. So thankful to them and happy Mochi is feeling so much better!! Thank you!!!🤍 …
Beware. The worth experience with them.beware from Ori. Zero stars. I took my dog there because of an infection two times. They charged me 400 twice. No resolution.
They are the worst hospital in Brickell. Beware.
Excellent service, all the staff were very friendly. My pet was super happy. Thank you so much!
Hi Charlotte, thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in us!

I have been using wags animal Hospital for my golden retriever for over a year for all of his appointments plus his neutering. They are the absolute best and I trust Dr. Jordan fully. Always very responsive and clear with their treatment plans - pricing is very fair. Highly recommend!

Traveling with a pet can be incredibly stressful, but Wags Animal Hospital in Brickell was absolute lifesavers! I needed to make sure all the health certificates and travel documents were 100% accurate for my toy poodle, Bella, and the team made the whole process completely hassle-free. Every doctor and staff member was kind, efficient, and thorough, ensuring every detail was taken care of so we had zero issues on our trip. They gave Bella so much attention and love while giving me complete peace of mind. If you’re looking for a top-tier, caring vet team in Miami especially for travel docs this is the place to go! It will be my main Vet in Miami

I just had the most wonderful experience at Wags Animal Hospital! Their location in Brickell Key is easy to find, it is also spotless and clean. But above all, the staff led by Dr. Ori Eizenberg, were all incredibly helpful and knowledgeable. My dog was very comfortable which is not the usual case when I take her to Vets. It was obvious that they all make the extra effort to treat the dogs with care and passion. Thank you very much!
Hi Mathias! We're fur-ever here for your pet's health and wellness. Thank you for choosing us.

I love this clinic, all the doctors who have already treated my dog, treated him very well and are very attentive, Dr. Lili is a great Vet who always treated my dog, the assistants are wonderful and affectionate. If you need a veterinarian for your pet, wags is definitely for you.

What first drew me to this clinic 5 years ago was the calm, family-like environment for my super reactive dog back then—now he’s a total teddy bear! Their kindness and compassion truly helped us through those challenges, and we still feel just as grateful today. The doctors are amazing, attentive, caring, and so is the entire team!

We brought our Persian cat to be checked today by Dr.Jordan and had the best experience! The nurses were so gentle and kind and Dr.Jordan sat with us for an hour explaining every result about Milo. It was such a great experience for both me and Milo and I am so happy we found WAG as our new vet! He truly cared so much about Milo and his health and brought us so much comfort.

5 STAR service, very professional in any way. Dr. Ori and his team are extremely knowledgeable and sweet. I needed a health certificate for international travel and was extremely nervous, but Dr. Ori was very kind and patient with me, he took time over phone, email and in person to calm my ass down LOL. That even worked on my dog, she was super calm as well and let Dr. Ori do his exam. She is usually very dramatic and vocal as the vet would be stabbing her, NOT with Dr. Ori :) The whole team is amazing!!!  Highly recommended!!!
Hi Jose, thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in us!
Wags always takes great care of my Mia. That's all that matters.

I love Wags! It was my second time here and felt right at home. My puppy doesn't even mind coming to the vet. Dr. Jordan is the best! He answered all of my questions thoroughly and really made me feel at ease with my concerns. Cannot recommend them enough!
Hi Sabrina, thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in us!
Hello Giulia, Thank you for the 5-star review!
The vets here are absolutely fabulous. They really take their time to explain things, listen to your journey, and meet your needs. Best vet I’ve found in Miami. :)

We’ve been taking our dogs, Lolla and Liz, to Wags Veterinary Hospital for the past 3 years, and they have always taken such great care of them. The entire team is caring, attentive, and truly loves animals. We are very grateful for all the support and excellent service throughout these years in Miami. They also offer fair pricing, which makes the experience even better. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate vet!

I cannot say enough amazing things about Wags Animal Hospital. Dr. Ori and Dr. Jordan are truly exceptional — they treat my dog as if he were their own and consistently go above and beyond in every way.

I travel frequently with my dog and, over the years, I’ve had to visit many different veterinarians both across the country and even within Miami. I can honestly say that no one compares to Dr. Ori and Dr. Jordan or the level of care, compassion, attention, and expertise they provide. Finding Wags Animal Hospital was such a relief and blessing.

They are incredibly skilled, knowledgeable, patient, and thorough, but what really sets them apart is how genuinely much they care. My dog absolutely loves them — and they are literally the only veterinarians he has ever enjoyed going to see. That alone says everything.

If you are looking for vets who will love and care for your pet like family while also providing top-tier medical care, Wags Animal Hospital is truly the best of the best.
Hi Eimy, thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in us!

The Wag animal hospital in my opinion is super expensive ! I did a yearly wellness for $725 , I try to pay with CareCredit the denied my payment! I will  be looking for a less expensive option and more flexibility in payments !

If you truly love your pets, please stay away from this clinic.

They are focused on making money, not on actual care. They constantly call and remind you about vaccinations and tell you to come anytime because that’s easy profit for them.

But when you have a real emergency, suddenly there is no availability. The doctor is always “busy” and cannot see your pet.

Today my dog is not feeling well and needs urgent attention. I am alone with a small child and a newborn, while my husband is out of town. I called the clinic, and once again, they refused to see us. They told me to make an appointment.

But emergencies don’t wait. Pets don’t choose when they get sick.

This level of indifference is unacceptable. I expected care and responsibility not this.

The vet I always wished I had. We have three dogs, so a veterinarian plays a very important role in our household. We stayed with our previous vets for many years—one retired and closed his clinic, and the other sold his practice. They were both good, but meeting Ori was a completely different experience.

With Ori, we found true excellence and genuine compassion. The entire experience, from beginning to end, has been nothing short of amazing. I highly recommend them

Extremely friendly team and nice location.  Felt very much at home and taken care of.  I wasn't with the other place I was going and my friend suggested this place.  They will be my new vet moving forward

We just moved from Boston and my corgi was in need of a vet for illness care. The Wags staff was able to get me in next day and it was the most friendly and seamless veterinary experience I've ever had. The staff was incredibly knowledgable and friendly with myself and my pup, even sitting on the floor with my corgi to make him feel more comfortable post exam. HIGHLY recommend Dr. Liliana and her staff and Wags will be our new vet here in Miami.

PS. Pricing was also very affordable compared to what we usually spend in Boston!

Thank you Dr. Jordan and the whole Wags family  -  Penny and I left our appointment today much more at ease and armed with knowledge and an action plan. Your expertise and compassion are second to none.

Choco has been going to Wags for over 6 years now. Dr Jordan and Ori have been great and most recently as well Dr. Laura. They truly take into consideration your feedback and the well-being of your fur baby.
Dr. Ori is phenomenal. He took the time to understand exactly why my dog (Lola) is having allergies and developed a plan to address them proactively.

We were very grateful to  Dr Jordan who cared for my dog  Canela with such kindness, patience, and professionalism. The detailed, proactive, warm, attentive approach made a big difference and gave us great peace of mind. Thank you for the excellent care.

Everyone at WAGS is amazing and you can tell they genuinely care about what they do.
Dr Jordan is the best and took exceptional care of my cat, supporting her needs every step of the way.
Cannot recommend them enough!
The best, the staff is so amazing and so nice that my dog actually gets excited going to the vet

We love Wags! Our dog Max is always excited to be going to the vet because everyone here from the front desk staff to the vet techs and Drs Ori and Jordan are incredible. We have had such a great experience here for the last 5 years and Dr Ori has been instrumental in helping us get Max ready for our move to Australia. We could not have gotten through this very difficult process without the Wags team. Thank you and we will miss you!

I had the most amazing experience at Wags Animal Hospital I've ever encountered.
I just moved to Miami and Wags Animal Hospital is right around the corner from where I live. I brought my cat Confucius in for a check-up and vaccination and the team couldn't have been more professional and adorable.
They took their time with Confucius, really going at his pace. He is a shy cat and I could see the change in him being treated so nicely, that he even started to look around the examination room. He received treats and scratches distracting him from the procedure and was very content. It couldn't have been nicer.
And then to my surprise, I received a follow up call the next day to check up on him after his vaccination. No vet has ever done this in the past for us and it made me feel very safe, seen and understood.
It was an absolute pleasure dealing with the staff and every member of this team and I can rest assured that my cat is in good hands with Wags Animal Hospital.
Cannot recommend them higher!
I can’t say enough about how caring, attentive and just plain wonderful everyone was at Wags Animal Hospital. Everyone that helped with my Lucy doted on her and took the best care of her. Thank you!!

I took my older dog in for dental cleaning and potential extractions. After sedation, I was informed that the cleaning would cost $980, and the extractions would be around $4,000. This felt like a significant overcharge. I requested to have my dog returned as soon as possible, but I was still charged $500 for blood tests. I’m disappointed with the lack of transparency and ethics in this experience. I won’t be returning!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Weinger ! He was incredibly kind and patient with my Chihuahua, who can be a little nervous at the vet. He took his time with her, making sure she felt comfortable and cared for. What impressed me the most was how thoroughly he went over her bloodwork, explaining everything in a way that was clear and easy to understand. He was so helpful, informative, and never made me feel rushed. It’s rare to find a vet who combines such professionalism with genuine compassion, and I truly feel my dog is in the best hands with him. Highly recommend Wags to anyone looking for a vet who truly cares about both pets and their owners!

Wags has been my dog’s vet for 3 years now. Every time I take Max to Wags, he is treated with great care. The staff is super friendly, and either Dr. Jordan or Dr. Lili always takes the time to examine him with patience and dedication. They are very kind and treat the pets with so much love and care.

Dr. Ori is so knowledgeable in this field and truly has a love for animals. He assisted me with a treatment plan for my dog just diagnosed with epicondylitis. He laid out all of the options for me and assisted every step of the way
I had the best experience with Dr. Laura and Stephany! My cat is very shy and they were amazing at making her feel safe. I highly recommend taking your pet here for any veterinary needs.

Recently moved to MIA and needed to find a good Vet for our 19 year old Morkie. We hit the jackpot with Wags! Dr Jordan, assistant Emily and staff were all stellar - 10+ out of 10!  And the facility is the cleanest we’ve ever experienced! Now if we could only find any close to this for our human Dr visits!!
Hi Miami, thank you for the 5-star rating. Enjoy your day!

Our sincere gratitude for the incredible care we received.
From the moment we walked in, everyone was so attentive and caring. The level of professionalism from every member of your team was superb. It's clear that you all have a genuine passion for what you do, and it made a huge difference in our experience. You truly went above and beyond.
Thank you again for everything.
Sincerely,
Bryan, Shane & Bella

Super great experience! Dr. Jordan & Celis were very patient with us and made sure our pup felt very comfortable. They made sure we had all our questions answered and provided a 10/10 experience! Will be back!
Fantastic first experience with my new Puppy.  Very clean place and pleasant staff.  Dr. Jordan is great.  Very accommodating as I was late :)

Wags Animal Hospital's Dr. Jordan is an excellent doctor who is very skilled and knowledgeable, and is kind and caring.  He explained in great detail my dog's foot injury, the potential causes, the treatment and prognosis.  I was very impressed with Dr. Jordan and felt very comfortable as though I was speaking with my good friend.  His office staff are very kind and caring as well, and his office feels like a family setting.  It is a pleasure visiting Wags Animal Hospital - even when I am worried about about my sick or injured dog - because of the special care my dogs and I receive there.  Thanks to Wags and Dr. Jordan for everything.  Very sincerely, Mikey, Teddy and Linda

Where do I begin… I have had such an amazing experience coming here & really appreciate all the love & support received from specifically Dr.Laura but also the whole team. My kitten was diagnosed with wet FIP back in February & when I brought her in for the first visit I immediately could tell this is a hospital & care team that really LOVES animals and cares. This hospital quite literally saved my kittens life. Unfortunately FIP is not the most well known easy to diagnose disease in cats, but again from the first visit Dr.Laura sprung into action, to help diagnose why my kitty was so sick. It was a journey, and we learned many things along the way but I am SO thankful for this hospital, Dr.Laura and every person who helped keep my kitten alive. This is a hospital that truly cares & I am so thankful I found them!

Thank you Dr. Laura for taking such good care of my kitty Skye:) We recently brought her in because she had congestion and sneezing and I was worried sick about her, but Dr. Laura saw us promptly and explained she could have a feline herpes virus which is super common in cats. She answered all of my questions  and since the virus is a chronic condition, she went  into depth about all the things we could to make her symptoms better long term aside from just meds. That’s a doctor who cares!! Our vet tech Celis was also super friendly and knowledgeable. Since our visit Dr. Laura has continued to check in and monitor Skye’s progress, and thanks to her Skye has made so much improvement. She cares about my pet as if it was her own and I’m so thankful for her and the wags family! Thank you guys❤️❤️

Rio and I absolutely love Wags!
We discovered Wags about three years ago when Rio was just a year old and came down with a terrible stomach flu. Dr. Jordan and Dr. Ori took such amazing care of him, and we’ve been loyal ever since.

They are truly the best  every time I have a question (even when it’s not an emergency), they always take the time to calm my nerves and guide me with care and compassion. The entire staff is wonderful  warm, responsive, and incredibly kind.

Anyone who knows me knows how much I love Rio and how committed I am to giving him the best. That’s exactly why we keep going back to Wags. Thank you all for giving us peace of mind and treating Rio like family.
Very happy with their Vets; customer service on phone and via text and staff while their with one or more of my Dogs.
Hi Christen, thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in us!

We love coming to Wags, our pet is always taken care of here! All the staff (Mercy, Dr. Ori, Dr. Jordan, Dr. Lili and all the veterinary assistants) are very friendly and accommodating. Their communication throughout the entire process (scheduling, prep appt, post appt) is so seamless

Brought my kitten in to check on some breathing issues she seemed to have.  As always I am impressed by the depth of knowledge Dr. Ori has with regards to his clients issues.  Added to that is the deep love he shows for the animals he treats.  It is genuine and is lovely to see towards our fur babies!
Hi Mark, thank you for the 5-star rating. Have a great day!

Wags is my go to veterinarian for my son Gibby. They always take the time and care to ensure I understand what is needed  and are always very patient in discussing my dogs particular needs and answer any questions I have. 10 out of 10 recommended.
Hi Nate, thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in us!

From the very start, we felt we were in good hands at Wags. Our cat is having a hard time during vet visits, so having a separate cat-only room made a huge difference. Dr. Jordan was always patient, took the time to walk us through everything and handled our anxious cat with real care.

We stayed with the clinic for over five years, and when it was time to move abroad, they were incredibly supportive in sorting out the pet health certificates. Even when our travel plans changed at the last minute and we had to redo all the paperwork, they handled everything quickly and without stress. Especially impressive given how confusing the process can be.

Dr. Jordan and his team aren’t just knowledgeable and reliable, they truly care. We’re so grateful for their help and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them!

Dr. Ori and Dr. Jordan are truly incredible vets, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the care they provide to my 14-year-old pug, Frannie. As she’s gotten older, I know I can trust them wholeheartedly with her well-being. Their guidance is always in her best interest, and I’ve never felt pressured to make a decision I wasn’t comfortable with.

Every single person in their office is also absolutely lovely. Every time Frannie walks through their doors, she’s treated like a superstar, greeted with smiles, affection, and genuine care. I can tell they love her as if she were their own, and that means the world to me.

If you’re looking for a team who are not only highly skilled but also compassionate and dedicated, Wag’s Brickell Key is simply the best. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with Frannie’s care.
